description.value: Cycle BC Rentals & Tours is a well-established Victoria rental operation celebrating over 30 years in business, offering city, kids, electric, gravel, and mountain bike rentals alongside motorcycle and scooter options. Staff can suggest routes, hidden back roads, restaurant picks, and safe riding tips, making it a convenient launchpad for visitors exploring the city or surrounding region by bike. It is one of only two Cycle BC locations in BC (the other in Vancouver), positioning it as one of the larger two-wheeled rental outfitters in the province.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, multi-location rental and tours operation (Victoria and Vancouver) offering city, e-bike, gravel, and mountain bike rentals, as well as guided tours — directly supporting 'Bike rentals' and 'Guided rides'. No mention of repairs, pump access, parts, or back-of-house cyclist amenities, so all mechanical/service criteria remain null. The OSM postcode V1W 1A6 is a Kelowna-area code and almost certainly incorrect for a 685 Humboldt Street, Victoria address, which should carry a V8W/V8V prefix — flagged as a data error.
concerns: OSM postcode V1W 1A6 appears to be a Kelowna-area postal code; a Humboldt Street Victoria address should carry a V8W or V8V prefix — likely an OSM data entry error.
OSM name is 'Cycle BC Rentals' but the website consistently uses 'Cycle BC Rentals & Tours' — minor name discrepancy.
Phone number (+1-250-380-2453) and email (info@cyclebc.ca) are present in OSM but not explicitly shown in the scraped website text, so they could not be directly confirmed from the website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A long-established (30+ years), active bike rental and tours business in central Victoria; touring cyclists visiting the city would benefit from knowing this is available as a rental and route-advice resource.
